text.offer: The carters who bring my ale come in along the edge of the Forest of Farol, and they've stopped coming. Centipedes, they say, as long as a man. Clear the road for them: ten should do it.
text.progress: The road runs along the western edge of the Forest of Farol, past the outskirts of Raza.
text.complete: The carters will be glad to hear it, and so am I. Drink's on the house next time.
